mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_report (application_id, patient_id, report_desc, report_result, findings, conclusion, attachment_url, attachment_name, operator_id, auditor_id, audit_time, audit_comment, status, complete_time, create_time) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{patientId}, #{reportDesc}, #{reportResult}, #{findings}, #{conclusion}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{attachmentName}, #{operatorId}, #{auditorId}, #{auditTime}, #{auditComment}, #{status}, #{completeTime}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM exam_report WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY create_time DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_report WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_report SET status = #{status}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, audit_time = SYSDATE, audit_comment = #{auditComment}, complete_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE complete_time END WHERE id = #{id}
